query: Trump approval rating registered voters latest September 2026 poll

results.content: This is a horizontal bar chart showing how 1,461 U.S. registered voters described President Trump in a Sept. 11–14, 2026, Economist/YouGov poll. The most commonly selected descriptions were “corrupt” (53%) and “dangerous” (51%), followed by “out-of-touch” (47%), “cruel” (46%), and “bold” and “racist” (45% each). Fewer voters described Trump as “strong” (37%), “intelligent” (35%), “effective” (33%), “honest” (23%), “inspiring” (19%), or “steady” (18%). [...] Methodology: This Economist-sponsored poll was taken September 11-14, 2026. Respondents were selected from YouGov's opt-in panel to be representative of adult U.S. citizens, and screened for voter registration. The margin of error is ± 3.

Among all poll respondents, 54% disapproved of the job Trump is doing as president and 31% approved. While Trump’s disapproval numbers in North Carolina have stayed roughly the same during 2026, his approval rating in this survey was the lowest recorded by the Elon University Poll since Trump took office in January 2025.

Stein had a 40% approval rating, a drop of 6% from the Elon University Poll conducted at the end of July. Stein’s disapproval numbers stayed steady at 25%.
